chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
The best of you is the one who is best to his wives, and I am the best of you to my wives.

key_terms.خَيْرُكُمْ: the best among you; the most excellent in character and conduct
key_terms.لِنِسَائِهِ: toward his wives; in relation to his marital treatment
key_terms.لِنِسَائِي: toward my wives; referring to the Prophet's own conduct with his wives

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about being good to one's wife?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a man's goodness is measured by how well he treats his wife. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله exemplifies the highest standard of conduct in family life and presents himself as the model for believers.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4538 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said:
"The best of you is the one who is best to his wives, and I am the best of you to my wives."
